title: Edge Node Schema
description: Base schema for all edge types in the IGVF Catalog. Defines common required properties.

_from.description: Document handle of the source node, in collection/key form, for example variants/NC_000001.11:10000:T:A.

_to.description: Document handle of the target node, in collection/key form, for example genes/ENSG00000129696.

label.description: The specific assay or relationship this edge represents, phrased for display, such as eQTL, allele-specific binding, or regulatory element effect on gene expression. Predicted edges carry a 'predicted' prefix, for example predicted allele-specific binding.

class.description: Evidence tier for the edge: 'observed data' for a direct experimental measurement, 'prediction' for the output of a computational model, and 'biological relationship' for a curated relationship drawn from an ontology or pathway database.

method.description: The assay, algorithm, or pipeline that generated the edge, such as MPRA, CRISPR screen, scE2G, or SEMVAR.

name.description: Predicate describing the relationship in the _from to _to direction, such as 'modulates expression of' or 'physically interacts with'.

inverse_name.description: Predicate describing the same relationship in the _to to _from direction, such as 'expression modulated by'. Identical to name for symmetric relationships such as 'physically interacts with'.

source.description: The dataset or consortium this edge was loaded from, such as IGVF, ENCODE, or BioGRID.

source_url.description: Link to the specific upstream record or file this edge was derived from, for example https://data.igvf.org/tabular-files/IGVFFI0332UGDD.
